versions.content: Read UDS DID authentication check On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), the Dcm shall check if the access to all requested DIDs outside the range 0xF200-0xF8FF is authenticated and read the data identifiers only if: • a DcmDspDidReadRole is configured for that DID and the verification according to [SWS_Dcm_01522] was successful or • the active white list on that connection has for each requested DID one entry with read access that matches that DID.
